blurb: Anchors Away Charters offers inshore, nearshore, and offshore fishing charters targeting species like snook, redfish, trout, grouper, snapper, and kingfish. They also provide boat cruises to Cabbage Key island, sunset cruises, sandbar trips, and dolphin tours. Trips are customized for all skill levels and group sizes, led by a USCG licensed captain with over 40 years of experience.

quotes.author: Christopher G Facebook Review
quotes.text: This was my first charter in the gulf and it was amazing. Jeff was very friendly and accommodating. We did the offshore fishing trip and he did everything right to make sure we had a great time. Throughout the trip we were constantly catching fish and when a hole dried up we were moving to another location. His equipment helped in ensuring that we maximized our opportunities and was always there to assist with landing the catch and making sure we had new bait right away. No question, I would recommend this charter. Thanks for the great time.-Christopher G Facebook Review

quotes.author: Jeremiah Ruis
quotes.text: Jeremiah Ruis2 years agoWe had an awesome day on the water with Captain Jeff. We couldn’t have asked for a more beautiful day and Captain Jeff worked hard to put us on the fish. We caught our limit of Grouper, along with plenty of Snapper, and Porgy for several meals. Jeff was patient and helped coach my 13 year old son, which I greatly appreciated and who ended up out fishing his dad with a 15 lb. Grouper. I highly recommend Anchor’s Away Charters and am looking forward to another trip in the future. Thank you Captain Jeff.

quotes.author: Sara Rae
quotes.text: Sara Rae2 years agoThere were five of us who went off shore finishing with Captain Jeff today and we had a great time! Capt Jeff was determined to find us a good spot and boy oh boy did he. We caught a ton of fish and had so much fun! Capt Jeff was patient with us and taught us everything we needed to know and even helped when we needed it! I can’t recommend Anchors Away and Capt Jeff enough. We can’t wait to go finishing again! If you are thinking about going this is your sign to book the trip and do it!

quotes.author: Darrell H Google Review
quotes.text: Awesome experience !! Best fishing guide out there. We went 40 miles offshore and was catching fish all day. Caught our limit of grouper and snapper. Captain Jeff cleaned our catch and bagged it to take home. He even provided an excellent recipe for the grouper that we tried the same night and it was amazing !! I've been on a lot of charters and this was probably the best one yet. Boat was spotless and clean. Captain Jeff was very professional . I highly recommend this charter.-Darrell H Google Review

quotes.author: Robert Dolard
quotes.text: Robert Dolard2 years agoCaptain Jeff is a safe, knowledgable, dedicated and interesting guy. If you have a small group you all will be landing fish and having fun. Our little group of 4 fishing and one observing slayed the Snapper (over 70 kept, many returned for another day) and 2 nice legal Grouper. Also had fun catch and release Blue Runners - great fun ! Great boat, outstanding Captain. If you want more you are more demanding than us - all ! Book him and You Will Not Regret It !

quotes.author: Ed Dieppa Google Review
quotes.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our charter out of Boca Grande with the captain. We went 38 miles out but he made us feel very safe and was very thoughtful of my grandsons. Most importantly, he put us on the fish and we fished until our arms were tired. Legal groupers, big mangrove snappers, lane snappers and a few other species was what we caught. New boat, highly recommended, he’s a consummate professional.-Ed Dieppa Google Review
